Attendance and checking during operation of the pump, the following should be 
checked:

items:
Check of flow rate 
 and delivery 
 head
Check the shaft seal for leaks

Check that the current absorbed by the motor dose not 
 exceed the rated value shown on the name plate

Check the
 pump 
 pressure

Fully open gate 
 valve (if any) in suction line and close gate valve in discharge line

Fill suction 
 line with liquid and completely prime pump

Stare the motor 
 (pump) immediately make a visual check of pump and suction piping for 
 pressure leaks

Check discharge piping for 
 pressure leaks

If pump is fitted with 
 pressure gauges open gauge cocks and take pressure reading for future 
 reference, verify that the pump is performing in accordance with parameter 
 specified in performance curve.

text:
Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection 
list I1, which must be performed on yearly 
bases as indicated by Y1 in the 
above title block.
This pump is used to transfer 
the clarified water from the 
clear well tank to primary filters
Technical Specifications:
Primary filter feed pump | P -(008-009-010)
Manufacturer | Paco
Model &Type | 11-3012-7 horizontal end suction centrifugal pump (LF)
Number of stages | 1
Speed | 1450 RPM CW
Power consumed | 9 KW
Liquid Handled | Clarified water
Capacity | 84 M3/H
Head | 30 M
NPSH | 3.63 M
Motor power | 20 HP/4 Pole
The first draft initiated by eng. Abdel Mageed 
Elhenawe, reviewed by eng. Hossam El-Din Mostafa, accepted by 
general manager eng. Magdy Okba, revised by 
MDEPC 
quality control 
eng. Magdy Hegazy, and approved by eng 
Ahmad Abd El-Meguid Sowan head sector of Nubaria PS.
This document accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilil 
MDEPC inspection & quality control general 
manager & MPIS coordinator, and 
certified by eng Mohamed Nageeb inspection & quality control's head sector.
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be 
 issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety 
 category.
Safety fence with 
 caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety and healthy 
 equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, breathing mask ...etc.
Isolate the circuit 
 breaker of the pump motor
Disconnect electric 
 terminals of the pump motor
Isolate the pump 
 mechanically by closing delivery and suction valves.
Be sure pump must be 
 completely drained.
Tools and 
Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set
Cleaning fluid, manual puller
Feeler 
 gauge, dial indicator
Vibrometer, straight edge, rags
Work to be carried out
Pump in operation
Check pump capacity, pressure and 
 power .
Check the noise of the 
 pump.
Measure vibration level for bearings and compare it with 
 the setting value then analyze it and determine what to do
Check the temperature of 
 bearing
Check the leakage of the 
 mechanical seal
Pump out of operation
Check alignment and adjust if 
 needed
Check the fixation
Starting 
 the Pump
Before starting the pump, the 
 following steps should be checked
Turn rotation element by hand to make sure it rotates 
 freely
Check the direction of rotation of motor before starting it 
 is clockwise
Fill the pump casing with the liquid
Check suction and discharge piping for leaks and make sure 
 for flange bolts are securely tighten need
Install coupling guard on flexible coupled unit
Attendance and checking during operation of the pump, the following should be 
checked:
Check of flow rate 
 and delivery 
 head
Check the shaft seal for leaks
Check that the current absorbed by the motor dose not 
 exceed the rated value shown on the name plate
Check the
 pump 
 pressure
Fully open gate 
 valve (if any) in suction line and close gate valve in discharge line
Fill suction 
 line with liquid and completely prime pump
Stare the motor 
 (pump) immediately make a visual check of pump and suction piping for 
 pressure leaks
Check discharge piping for 
 pressure leaks
If pump is fitted with 
 pressure gauges open gauge cocks and take pressure reading for future 
 reference, verify that the pump is performing in accordance with parameter 
 specified in performance curve.
